description.narrative: Contribuir al aumento de la competitividad de la produccin nacional y a elevar el nivel de vida de la poblacin rural, incrementando y manteniendo el nivel de servicio de una parte sustancial de la red prioritaria de caminos vecinales.

To contribute to generate a higher level of competitiveness of the national production and to improve the living conditions of the rural population, increasing and maintaining the level of service of a substantial portion of the main rural road network.
